scorer: official NepTel scorer (word-Levenshtein on nepali_normalize text, 6 wps rate gate)

harness_sanity_check.note: reproduction matches published to rounding, harness sound

metrics.neptel: real Nepali call-center telephony, about 76 scored segments
metrics.general_nepali: 200 held-out clean read clips (OpenSLR-54), human references

results.note: base model, strong on clean audio

failed_finetunes_neptel.note: all regressed, cause is label-style mismatch, not model or recipe

decoding_levers_base_neptel.note: ortho canon helps base by about 1.6 but hurts kriti-telephony (31.32 to 31.78); shipped number uses no post-processing

baseline_note: kriti-baseline.neptel.json is NepaliConformer's published Kriti output (40.84); kriti-baseline-redecode.neptel.json is our independent re-decode (40.75). Both match Kriti's published 40.6, harness verified two ways.
